first_accepted_patch:
--- a/rtl/counter.v
+++ b/rtl/counter.v
@@ -25,7 +25,7 @@
         if (!reset_n) begin
             val_out <= {WIDTH_BITS{1'b0}};
         end else begin
-            if (val_out >= limit_val) begin
+            if (val_out == limit_val) begin
                 val_out <= {WIDTH_BITS{1'b0}};
             end else begin
                 val_out <= val_out + 1'b1;
             end
         end
     end

parsed_output.root_cause: The comparison `val_out >= limit_val` incorrectly allows val_out to equal limit_val before resetting, causing an off-by-one error where the counter reaches one value beyond the intended terminal count before wrapping. This results in val_out being one greater than expected at the point where term_reached should be true.

--- a/rtl/counter.v
+++ b/rtl/counter.v
@@ -25,7 +25,7 @@
         if (!reset_n) begin
             val_out <= {WIDTH_BITS{1'b0}};
         end else begin
-            if (val_out >= limit_val) begin
+            if (val_out == limit_val) begin
                 val_out <= {WIDTH_BITS{1'b0}};
             end else begin
                 val_out <= val_out + 1'b1;
             end
         end
     end
